items.author: CNA
items.summary: Hundreds of starving and exhausted residents left the town of Oleshky on Friday during a US-backed local ceasefire, the first of its kind and the longest humanitarian pause in the war, which is nearing its fifth year.
items.body:

Residents of Russian-controlled Ukrainian town arrive in Belarus

Hundreds of starving and exhausted residents left the town of Oleshky on Friday during a US-backed local ceasefire, the first of its kind and the longest humanitarian pause in the war, which is nearing its fifth year.

People attend an evacuation from the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky, amid Russia's attack on Ukraine, in the Kherson region, in this handout picture released Oct 30, 2026. Head of the Office of the President of Ukraine, Kyrylo Budanov/Handout via Reuters

FAST

KYIV: Four planes carrying residents evacuated from the Russian-controlled Ukrainian town of Oleshky landed in Belarus on Saturday (Oct 31), the Belarusian Belta state news agency and a senior Ukrainian official said.
Hundreds of starving and exhausted residents left the town of Oleshky on Friday during a US-backed local ceasefire, the first of its kind and the longest humanitarian pause in the war, which is nearing its fifth year.
"The last, fourth plane landed in Gomel," said David Arakhamia, a top Ukrainian peace negotiator and close ally of President Volodymyr Zelenskiy.
"In a few hours, all Ukrainian citizens evacuated from Oleshky together with a Ukrainian delegation will be on Ukrainian territory."

Belta later reported that a convoy of buses carrying the residents had departed from the airport in Gomel, in southeastern Belarus near the border with Ukraine.
The evacuees leaving for Ukraine had to take a complicated route to leave Oleshky as the frontline runs just a few kilometres away.
They first travelled by bus via Crimea to the Russian town of Anapa before flying to Belarus from where they will continue to Ukraine via a border crossing, Belta said.
The local ceasefire in Oleshky was reached thanks to mediation efforts by US first lady Melania Trump and with the pope's involvement. The ceasefire has been holding since Tuesday without violations, according to both Ukrainian and Russian officials. It has allowed them to de-mine the roads and bring food, medicines and other supplies into the town.
Supply routes to Oleshky were disrupted by fighting and drones. According to some residents, food deliveries were stopped in May, pushing hundreds of people into starvation.
It was not immediately clear how many people decided to leave Oleshky and how many opted to stay in the town. Oleshky residents had options to travel to Russia or to return to Ukraine.
Ukrainian officials have said around 1,700 people remained in Oleshky from a pre-war population of about 24,000. According to several residents interviewed by Reuters, many of those were elderly or ill.

Source: Reuters/kl

items.title: CCI clears Xavier Niel's 5.1 bn euro Vodafone stake acquisition, 3 deals
items.author: Shubham Kumar
items.summary: The regulator also approved transactions involving Prosus-backed Navi, Aditya Birla Renewables' acquisition of Solenergi Power and Adani Energy Solutions' purchase of IntelliSmart Infrastructure ...
items.body: The Competition Commission of India (CCI) on Friday approved four major corporate transactions, headlined by French telecom billionaire Xavier Niel's 5.1 billion euro acquisition of a 16.2 per cent stake in UK-based telecommunications major Vodafone Group PLC. The Vodafone transaction is being executed through Vega SAS, a French holding company and subsidiary of Maya SAS, which serves as Niel's family investment vehicle. Under an agreement first announced in July, Vega SAS is purchasing the 16.2 per cent stake from Emirates Telecommunications Group Co PJSC. Upon completion, Vega SAS will emerge as the single largest shareholder in Vodafone Group. Although Vega SAS does not have direct business operations in India, the transaction required mandatory review by the Indian competition regulator because of Vodafone's substantial domestic presence through its joint venture, Vodafone Idea Ltd. Under Indian competition laws, global acquisitions crossing specified financial or ownership thresholds require CCI clearance to ensure they do not adversely affect competition in domestic markets. The investment comes as Vodafone Group undergoes a major corporate restructuring across its European and African operations. The company has recently divested its Spanish and Italian businesses and completed a major network merger in the UK. Alongside the global telecom transaction, the CCI approved three domestic deals spanning financial technology, renewable energy and power infrastructure. In the fintech sector, the regulator approved the acquisition of a stake in Navi Ltd by MIH Payments Holdings BV. The acquirer is an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of global investment group Prosus NV and functions as an investment holding vehicle with portfolio companies operating in India. Navi Ltd is the holding company of the Navi Group, which offers consumer-facing financial products and services through its subsidiaries via a unified mobile application. In the energy sector, the CCI approved Aditya Birla Renewables' acquisition of Solenergi Power from Shell Overseas Investment BV. Solenergi is a Mauritius-registered holding company with strategic interests in several solar and wind power generation entities across India. Additionally, the CCI approved Adani Energy Solutions' acquisition of 100 per cent of IntelliSmart Infrastructure from the National Investment and Infrastructure Fund (NIIF) and Energy Efficiency Services Ltd. Both companies specialise in advanced electricity metering infrastructure, while IntelliSmart also deploys smart gas meters. The regulator said detailed formal orders for all four transactions would be issued separately.

RAWALPINDI: Pakistan’s military is “cautiously optimistic” about its mediation between Iran and the United States, its spokesman said on Friday (Oct 30) in his first interview since a high-level delegation visited Tehran this week.
Army chief Field Marshal Asim Munir - Pakistan's chief mediator in its efforts to de-escalate the now eight-month-old Iran war - has been to Tehran twice this month, most recently on Monday alongside Saudi and Turkish officials.
“Why would the Field Marshal be going twice if it is not for some positivity? So yes, of course,” spokesman Lieutenant General Ahmed Sharif Chaudhry said when asked whether the trips were a positive sign.
“The word that we would use is always cautiously optimistic,” added Chaudhry, director general of Inter-Services Public Relations.

There were still "powerful spoilers and detractors" who believed conflict serves them, he added without naming them.
Speaking in the garrison city of Rawalpindi, where Pakistan's armed forces are headquartered, Chaudhry declined to say what was discussed or whether the United States had backed the trip.
Saudi Defence Minister Prince Khalid bin Salman and Turkish intelligence chief Ibrahim Kalin joined Munir in Tehran on Monday.
Their two countries signed a joint defence pact with Pakistan on Aug 7, saying an attack on any signatory will be treated as an attack on all.
The Mecca Joint Defence Agreement has taken on added significance as the Iran war has redrawn regional alliances and raised fears of a broader Middle East conflict.
While the three signatories say the agreement is aimed at collective deterrence and regional security, analysts see its evolution as closely tied to efforts by regional powers to manage the fallout from the Iran-US confrontation.
After Monday’s talks, Mohsen Rezaei, secretary of Iran’s Supreme National Security Council, said regional security should be ensured by regional countries without foreign intervention.
The wording of the pact does not bar new members, Chaudhry said on Friday when asked whether Iran could join.
“Anyone who has a shared vision of collective deterrence and regional peace, why not? Everyone is most welcome,” he said, adding that it was for the political leadership of the three principal parties to decide.
Asked whether more Pakistani troops were being sent to Saudi Arabia under the agreement, Chaudhry said that would depend on the situation and the decision of both countries’ political leadership.
He said Pakistan was committed to defending Saudi Arabia and the holy sites of Mecca and Medina. "We are not part of the Yemeni conflict, which is an intra-Yemen conflict," he added.
Fighting between Saudi Arabia and Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthi group has been reignited by the Iran conflict, stoking fears of a wider war.
HOME FRONT On the home front, the federal government suspended the provincial government in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, led by jailed former prime minister Imran Khan’s Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI), on Oct 11 and detained Chief Minister Sohail Afridi.

RAWALPINDI: Pakistan’s military is “cautiously optimistic” about its mediation between Iran and the United States, its spokesman said on Friday (Oct 30) in his first interview since a high-level delegation visited Tehran this week.
Army chief Field Marshal Asim Munir - Pakistan's chief mediator in its efforts to de-escalate the now eight-month-old Iran war - has been to Tehran twice this month, most recently on Monday alongside Saudi and Turkish officials.
“Why would the Field Marshal be going twice if it is not for some positivity? So yes, of course,” spokesman Lieutenant General Ahmed Sharif Chaudhry said when asked whether the trips were a positive sign.
“The word that we would use is always cautiously optimistic,” added Chaudhry, director general of Inter-Services Public Relations.

There were still "powerful spoilers and detractors" who believed conflict serves them, he added without naming them.

Saudi Defence Minister Prince Khalid bin Salman and Turkish intelligence chief Ibrahim Kalin joined Munir in Tehran on Monday.
Their two countries signed a joint defence pact with Pakistan on Aug 7, saying an attack on any signatory will be treated as an attack on all.
The Mecca Joint Defence Agreement has taken on added significance as the Iran war has redrawn regional alliances and raised fears of a broader Middle East conflict.
While the three signatories say the agreement is aimed at collective deterrence and regional security, analysts see its evolution as closely tied to efforts by regional powers to manage the fallout from the Iran-US confrontation.
After Monday’s talks, Mohsen Rezaei, secretary of Iran’s Supreme National Security Council, said regional security should be ensured by regional countries without foreign intervention.
The wording of the pact does not bar new members, Chaudhry said on Friday when asked whether Iran could join.
“Anyone who has a shared vision of collective deterrence and regional peace, why not? Everyone is most welcome,” he said, adding that it was for the political leadership of the three principal parties to decide.
Asked whether more Pakistani troops were being sent to Saudi Arabia under the agreement, Chaudhry said that would depend on the situation and the decision of both countries’ political leadership.
He said Pakistan was committed to defending Saudi Arabia and the holy sites of Mecca and Medina. "We are not part of the Yemeni conflict, which is an intra-Yemen conflict," he added.

FAST

SEPANG, Malaysia, Oct 31 : KTM's Pedro Acosta won a thrilling Malaysian Grand Prix sprint at the Sepang International Circuit on Saturday, while Ducati's Marc Marquez finished second, capitalising on MotoGP title rival Jorge Martin's withdrawal.
Gresini Racing's pole sitter Alex Marquez crashed out of the lead on lap three, while Trackhouse rider Ai Ogura, who led for most of the 10-lap sprint, conceded positions towards the end to finish fourth, behind Aprilia's Marco Bezzecchi.
Rain had threatened to play spoilsport in Sepang but the leading pack crossed the finish line of the 10-lap sprint just before the heavens opened up.
"Normally in mixed conditions I don't do a good job. But anyway, today was the day to try," Acosta said after his second sprint victory of the season.

"I was playing for nothing. Also knowing that Marc was behind fighting for the championship ... It was my opportunity to try to make something different from this."
Martin withdrew after persistent wrist pain hampered his comeback from a fracture, with the Spaniard acknowledging that his title hopes were "already lost".
The sprint podium extended reigning champion Marc's lead over Martin to 19 points, with the Ducati rider set to increase his advantage further in Sunday's race.
'I DIDN'T WANT TO LEAD'
Marc said he was happy to finish second, avoiding any risks in treacherous conditions in some parts of the circuit.
"The guys that are not fighting for the championship can take more risk. I was calm," Marc said.
"I had the pace, but I didn't want to lead the race because the one that arrives first is the one that normally crashes."
Alex had snatched pole position from his brother, and the Gresini Racing rider stormed into the lead at turn one, while Marc fell to fourth when he was overtaken by an aggressive Ogura, who forced Acosta to take evasive action.
But dark clouds loomed over the circuit while spots of rain appeared at the track and Alex — who won the race here last year — crashed out of the lead on lap three at turn 13, giving Ogura the lead.
Prima Pramac's Jack Miller gambled on an early pit stop, but the Australian was left furious after his team failed to have his spare Yamaha bike fitted with wet tyres in time.
BIKE SWAP GAMBLE
Only the backmarkers rolled the dice on a bike swap while the leaders stayed out, convinced that the rapidly drying track did not justify a switch to wet tyres.
Ogura and Acosta traded places with three laps remaining, but the Japanese rider came off worse in the exchange, leaving the door open for Marc to overtake and move into second while Bezzecchi also climbed to third.
"I knew I could manage well to have something for the end, and then the rain came, so it was a little bit unexpected and I saw the others were struggling a bit," said Bezzecchi, who is 52 points behind Marc in third.
"Step by step, I was catching (up) and I was closer. Unfortunately, I didn't catch them early enough to try to battle with Marc."

SEPANG, Oct 31 : Aprilia's Jorge Martin said on Saturday his MotoGP title challenge was effectively over after withdrawing from the Malaysian Grand Prix to continue his recovery from a wrist fracture.
The 2024 champion pulled out before qualifying at Sepang after struggling with the injury he suffered in a sprint-race crash at Phillip Island last weekend.
The 28-year-old trails championship leader Marc Marquez by 10 points with four rounds remaining, including the Malaysian GP.
"I don't have to think about the championship. Maybe I can win it, but for me it's already lost," Martin told reporters.

Martin said he had pushed to race at Sepang but lacked the strength under braking needed to compete at the highest level, prompting the decision to withdraw rather than risk aggravating the injury.
"I felt that I could ride with almost no pain, but for maybe one lap," the Spaniard said.
"After that I started to have a lot of pain, I couldn't be constant, so watching a bit the lap times and my performance, we decided to stop, to try to wait.
"We thought together with the team that the effort I was doing was too much to continue and nothing to gain. It was just going to be very difficult even to score one point."

MEXICO CITY, Oct 30 : Red Bull's Max Verstappen and Racing Bulls' Liam Lawson received one-place grid drops after they collided on track in Friday's Mexico City Grand Prix second practice session.
Both drivers were also given a penalty point each after the two cars hit each other side on.
Stewards heard from both after the session, with the drivers agreeing what had happened was unnecessary and clumsy.
The stewards said in a statement they decided to escalate the penalty from the usual formal warning to a grid position drop because they had warned team managers earlier in the light of similar incidents this year between drivers in practice.

The pair — both contracted to Red Bull, which owns the two teams — went wheel to wheel 13 minutes into the session, with four-time world champion Verstappen diving down the inside of Lawson at Turn 12. The New Zealander held his ground through Turn 13 before they made contact.
The contact scattered debris across the track, with the session halted for it to be cleared.
Lawson and Verstappen were teammates at Red Bull this year while Isack Hadjar was injured and also briefly for two races at the start of last season.
"Maybe not very smart behaviour what he was trying to do there," Verstappen told reporters before seeing the stewards. "At the end of the day, it is not going to change my weekend, but if I were him, I would act a little smarter, and when you're fighting for your seat, it's not very smart behaviour.
"That's not very sensible behaviour from someone in his position, to pick a fight with me." 
Lawson, who has yet to be confirmed by Racing Bulls for next season, said over the team radio, "He literally just drove into me."
Racing Bulls team boss Alan Permane was not impressed by either driver.
"One word — unnecessary. And I say that of both of them. I haven't heard what Max has said. I'm sure he's got his opinions and I'm sure Liam has his opinion. But mine is, it's just not needed and they can both do better," he told the BBC.   

Source: Reuters

WASHINGTON: HKT, a leading Hong Kong telecom carrier and subsidiary of PCCW Ltd, on Friday (Oct 30) agreed to halt its operations in the United States under pressure from the Federal Communications Commission.
The FCC in October 2025 said it was moving to revoke the authority of HKT to operate in the United States, citing national security concerns and its affiliation with China Unicom, which is a shareholder in PCCW. Under a consent decree reviewed by Reuters, HKT has agreed to stop international and domestic telecom services to and within the United States.
HKT must file an application with the FCC within 30 days to discontinue services and must discontinue US services by September 1, 2027. PCCW declined immediate comment.
The agreement means the FCC will not move forward with the revocation proceeding that could have offered more details on Washington's national security concerns.

The FCC has previously barred China Mobile, China Telecom and China Unicom from providing international telecommunications services to the United States, citing broad national security concerns.
The Trump administration has continued an extensive crackdown on Chinese telecoms over the past year. The FCC on Thursday voted to ban all Chinese labs from testing US electronics starting from December 2028.
The telecom crackdown has sparked a strong reaction from Beijing. China said Friday it firmly opposes the FCC action on labs, warning it would take necessary countermeasures "if the US side persists in acting unilaterally".
The FCC also announced on Thursday it plans to soon ban Chinese telecom firms from direct access to US phone numbers on national security grounds. The plan would bar Chinese IP network service providers from direct access and those that use equipment from companies on the FCC's list that pose national security risks, including Huawei and ZTE.
Other measures under consideration by the FCC include barring Chinese telecom firms from connecting to US networks and from operating their data centers in the US. 
Concerns about the potential for spying and other harms to arise from Chinese access to US telecom data and infrastructure have grown in recent years.
In late 2024, Washington said a Chinese state-sponsored cyber espionage group known as Salt Typhoon stole consumers' call records and US call data and infiltrated US telecommunications and telecom infrastructure firms.
China has consistently denied any wrongdoing.

SEPANG, Malaysia, Oct 31 : Gresini Racing's Alex Marquez stormed to a thrilling pole position at the Malaysian MotoGP on Saturday as 2024 champion Jorge Martin withdrew from the race weekend to continue his recovery from a wrist fracture.
Alex snatched pole away from elder brother and reigning champion Marc Marquez with his final flying lap at the Sepang International Circuit, denying the Ducati rider after he appeared set to claim top spot in the closing moments of Q2.
The pole was only the third of Alex's MotoGP career and his first of the season.
"I wasn't expecting to make that lap time, honestly speaking, but already the first time attack was really good for me," Alex said.

"It was already in the 1:56s, so much better than I was expecting ... I couldn't believe it. I put everything together. Everything was working really well on the bike."
Martin, who cut short Friday's practice to aid his recovery from the injury suffered in a sprint-race crash at Phillip Island last weekend, briefly took part in Saturday morning's practice session.
However, the Spaniard was visibly struggling and did not take part in Q1, ending his weekend.
"We decided together with the doctors to not continue," Aprilia team manager Paolo Bonora told broadcasters.
"His feeling was better, to be honest, compared to yesterday, but he was not able to force during the braking, so we decided all together to not continue and to keep focus on the Doha GP."
Alex clocked a lap of 1:56.493 to secure pole, with Marc finishing 0.070 seconds adrift in second after surging from fifth position to briefly put himself on course for pole.
Pedro Acosta completed the front row after another impressive qualifying performance for KTM.
Aprilia's Ai Ogura and Marco Bezzecchi qualified fourth and fifth, respectively, with Fabio Di Giannantonio taking sixth in a tightly contested session.
LCR Honda's Johann Zarco and Ducati rider Francesco Bagnaia advanced to Q2 after navigating the opening qualifying session, but Bagnaia endured a frustrating afternoon.
The Italian briefly climbed up the order before running wide at Turn One and venting his frustration by striking the windscreen of his Ducati after returning to the pits.

Source: Reuters

items.summary_source: The China-Global South Project source metadata
items.body:
SoftBank-backed digital-payments company OPay withdrew a planned $304 million U.S. initial public offering on Friday, citing a regulatory inquiry by a foreign jurisdiction it did not identify.

The Nigeria-focused company described the inquiry as relating to a jurisdiction “immaterial” to its core operations. In a statement, it did not identify the regulator or nature of the inquiry.

OPay said it expected the matter to be resolved satisfactorily in the near future and that the probe “should not be misconstrued as a reflection on the Company’s business performance, financial condition, operational integrity, or regulatory standing.”

The company said the inquiry would not affect its operations, regulatory standing or customer service in Nigeria or its other markets.

OPay could not immediately be reached for comment outside office hours.

Earlier in the day, OPay said it had priced 16 million American depositary shares at $19 each, the bottom of its targeted $19-to-$21 range, valuing the company at about $4 billion.

Japanese tech investor SoftBank Group 9984.T, whose entities owned a 6.6% stake in OPay before the offering, did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

Numerous companies worldwide have delayed stock market listings in recent weeks as stubborn inflation and a selloff in AI-related stocks have weighed on investor sentiment.

OPay, founded in 2018, provides digital financial services across emerging markets, including Nigeria and Indonesia.

Its app offers payments, money transfers, savings and loans in economies where limited access to traditional banking can make everyday transactions difficult.

OPay was founded by Chinese billionaire Yahui Zhou, who also founded Beijing Kunlun Tech, a Chinese gaming company that previously owned dating app Grindr.

The fintech raised $400 million in 2021 at a valuation of $2 billion. It had about 50 million monthly active users as of July 31, according to its IPO prospectus.

Citigroup, Deutsche Bank, Standard Bank and CICC were among the underwriters. The company had planned to list on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “OPay.”

items.title: Trump clears $2.1 bn Patriot missile deal for Ukraine after Zelenskyy tensions: Is his Ukraine policy changing?
items.author: Swati Gandhi
items.summary: The US has approved a $2.1 billion sale of 500 Patriot missiles to Ukraine after weeks of tensions between Trump and Zelenskyy. Allies will help finance the purchase, but delivery delays remain a concern as Kyiv seeks protection from Russian attacks. What does this mean for US policy on Ukraine?
items.body: After weeks of tension between US President Donald Trump and his Ukrainian counterpart Volodymyr Zelenskyy, Washington on Friday (local time) approved the sale of 500 Patriot PAC-3 missiles to Kyiv, the State Department announced.According to Reuters, the sale of 500 Patriot missiles has been approved at an estimated cost of $2.1 billion, in what is being considered one of the most significant steps to supply defensive weapons to war-torn Ukraine since the start of the second Trump administration. US approves Patriot missile sale for Ukraine: What we knowThe development comes at a time when Ukraine has long said it urgently requires more missile interceptors to defend against increasingly large Russian missile attacks. The Patriot system is Kyiv's most effective defence against high-speed ballistic missiles.Delayed missile deliveries have added to a growing list of tensions for Ukraine, especially after Trump announced a diesel deal with Russia and waived sanctions related to Moscow under the Graham Act. The US President also slammed Zelenskyy for the country's unwillingness to stop attacks on Russia's energy infrastructure.Earlier this week, the Ukrainian President said that Kyiv had been waiting for over a month for Washington to sign off on critical missile supplies as Russia intensified its attacks on energy and civilian infrastructure across the country.According to the report, despite its urgent need, Ukraine is likely to face a lengthy wait for the interceptors. Arms deals often take years to complete, and two people briefed on the US decision said the missiles have yet to be built, with deliveries not expected until the early 2030s.Who's paying for the 500 Patriot missiles?In a statement, the State Department announced that Kyiv will pay for these 500 Patriot missiles with contributions from Canada, Germany, and Norway channelled through a programme called US JUMPSTART, along with national funds financed by the European Union's Ukraine Support Loan.The department said, "This proposed sale will support the foreign policy and national security objectives of the United States by improving the security of a partner country that is a force for political and economic stability in Europe."It further noted, "Ukraine will pay for this purchase with donations from Canada, Germany, and Norway via the JUMPSTART program and national funds, financed by the European Union's Ukraine Support Loan."According to a Pentagon website, the US JUMPSTART programme allows allies to make donations to buy weapons, services, and training for Kyiv to support its self-defence following Moscow's invasion.Previously, the JUMPSTART programme was used in August to purchase 3,350 air-launched cruise missiles worth $825 million made by Zone 5 Technologies and CoAspire.What's changing in Trump's Ukraine policy?The Patriot sale suggests that Washington remains willing to supply defensive weapons to Ukraine despite Trump’s recent criticism of Zelenskyy. However, the purchase is being financed through allied contributions and European Union-backed funds. Alongside Trump’s diesel deal with Russia and sanctions waivers, the approval points to continued military support for Kyiv without establishing a broader change in Washington’s approach to the war.(with agency inputs)

BEIJING: China's factory activity unexpectedly dropped in October, its third contraction in four months, a government survey showed on Saturday (Oct 31), hurt by soft demand for exports as well as goods at home.
The official manufacturing purchasing managers' index (PMI) fell to 49.3 from 50.1 in September, according to data from the National Bureau of Statistics. That missed a forecast for 50.0 from a Reuters poll.
Factory activity weakened as overseas Christmas-related orders, which were front-loaded in September, cooled in October. It was also hurt when consumer spending, which climbed during China's long National Day holiday in the first week of October, fizzled out after, in a return to its long-stagnant state.
"Insufficient demand is increasing downward pressure on the economy," said Zhang Liqun, an analyst with the China Federation of Logistics & Purchasing, adding that policymakers should take the problem seriously and step up measures as soon as possible.

Sub-indexes for new orders overall and for new export orders both stayed in contraction territory in October. Production and purchasing activity also slipped into contraction from expansion.
The non-manufacturing PMI, which covers services and construction, also dropped to 49.7 from 50.2 in September.
The readings are compiled based on purchasing managers' reports about whether conditions improved, worsened or were unchanged in areas such as new orders, output and employment compared with the previous month. A reading above 50 signals expansion, while one below 50 indicates contraction.
Some sectors within manufacturing were doing well.
Production and new orders sub-indexes for railway, shipbuilding, aerospace equipment, and computer, communications and electronics manufacturing were all at or above 53.0, the survey showed.
AI-related firms in particular have reported strong earnings growth. Zhongji Innolight, a maker of high-speed optical modules that connect servers and switches in AI data centres, posted a near tripling in third-quarter net profit.
But the lacklustre domestic market and rising costs have weighed on many old-school manufacturers and property-linked firms. Custom furniture maker Oppein Home, for example, saw net profit plunge 80 per cent during the quarter.
China's economy is, however, expected to meet the country's 4.5-5.0 per cent annual growth target without additional stimulus measures after third-quarter growth rebounded to 4.5 per cent from 4.3 per cent in April-June.

Source: Reuters/kl

items.title: Binance crypto exchange's $6.3 bn heist rattles crypto, draws scrutiny
items.author: Bloomberg
items.summary: The US agencies are coordinating with private-sector partners to assess the breach and recover stolen funds, while Binance pledged to cover all losses ...
items.body: By Myles Miller, Emily Nicolle and Scott Patterson US law enforcement joined the hunt for hackers who drained more than $6 billion from the Binance crypto exchange in the biggest cyber theft ever recorded. The Federal Bureau of Investigation is aware of the incident and is coordinating with its partners “to understand the scope of the activity, evaluate potential impacts, and coordinate appropriate investigative steps,” the agency said in a statement to Bloomberg News on Friday. Secret Service investigators are also “working around the clock” with the private sector to recover stolen funds, a spokesperson said. The Justice Department is aware of reports about the attack but does not comment on investigations, a spokesperson said.  While the full details of the Binance breach have yet to emerge, the incident comes amid growing concern about the risks posed by hackers in the age of artificial intelligence. Other recent cyberattacks have hit prediction market Polymarket, South Korean financial firms Mirae Asset Global Investments Co. and Daishin Securities, as well as Japanese currency trading platform GMO Internet Group Inc. The world’s largest crypto trading platform suspended withdrawals and pledged to cover all losses. The exchange is able to do so as a result of its ongoing investment of revenue into cryptocurrencies, Binance co-Chief Executive Officer Richard Teng said in a video posted on social media on Friday. Yi He, who is co-CEO, said Binance’s revenue for this year would completely cover the amount lost. Withdrawals were expected to resume by Sunday. “Most of what we earn from day-to-day operations is held in cryptoassets,” Teng said. “That is precisely why we are able to absorb a loss of this size, immediately, with our own money.”   Americans are prohibited from using the exchange. Binance.US is a smaller, separate entity.  The hack comes at a time when the Trump administration and its regulators have been pushing for mainstream adoption of cryptocurrencies and blockchain technology. In September, the Securities and Exchange Commission approved the so-called Innovation Exemption, which allows for public company stocks to trade on blockchains. The Binance hack is likely to raise concerns among public company executives about adopting such technology, experts said. The Commodity Futures Trading Commission, for its part, recently unveiled a proposal to regulate digital asset transactions and markets. If finalized, the measure would regulate leveraged crypto trades offered to retail customers and establish a new category for crypto exchanges offering the leveraged trades to register with the agency. “There need to be delays and checkpoints” in transactions, said Austin Campbell, a crypto expert and former banker who is now an adjunct professor at the NYU Stern School of Business, drawing an analogy to automobile safety. “The car can be faster, cheaper and more gas efficient if we take out all the airbags and seatbelts,” he said.       Blockchain intelligence firms TRM Labs, Chainalysis and Elliptic have all pointed to North Korea as being behind the Binance heist, with Chainalysis labeling the incident as “the largest in the history of crypto, and one of the single-largest financial crimes of all time.” The funds drained in the attack were a mix of the largest cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ether, and the dollar-backed stablecoins USDT and USDC. Bitcoin fell on news of the Binance attack, dropping below $77,000 for the first time in more than a month. The largest currency traded near the lows of the day for much of Friday.   For the crypto faithful who’d been basking in a two-month-long price rebound, the Binance incident has cast a shadow over the recovery. Binance dwarfs its industry rivals. It holds roughly $135.2 billion in assets, compared with $28.6 billion at the second-largest exchange OKX, according to DefiLlama data.   Binance said the incident may involve a compromised software engineer’s laptop, as well as “additional points of breach.” It found no evidence of leaked private keys, it said. “This was a complex attack, and we are doing all we can in coordination with law enforcement to resolve it,” Binance said in a post on X. An emergency insurance and reserve fund from Binance called the Secure Asset Fund for Users (SAFU) was established in 2018 to serve as a backstop for customers in “extreme situations,” according to the exchange. The SAFU is generally maintained at around $1 billion, but has fluctuated in the past in tandem with market movements, Binance said in 2024. The two biggest stablecoin issuers said they took steps to freeze affected currency. Paolo Ardoino, the chief executive officer of Tether, said in an X post that it froze more than $1.5 billion of the stablecoin USDT “related to a potential Binance exchange hack.” Jeremy Allaire, who runs Circle Internet Group Inc., said $800 million of its USDC token had been frozen amid “reports of a potential exploit involving Binance.”

items.title: 中国製造業ＰＭＩ、10月は49.3　4カ月で3度目の縮小
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [北京 ３１日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[北京 ３１日 ロイター] - 中国国家統計局が３１日発表した１０月の製造業購買担当者景気指数（ＰＭＩ）は４９．３に低下し、景気拡大と縮小の分岐点となる５０を下回った。製造業活動が縮小したのは過去４カ月で３度目。国内の財需要の低迷と輸出の弱まりの兆しが重しとなった。

ロイターがまとめた市場予想の５０．０を下回った。９月は５０．１だった。

製造業活動が弱まったのは、９月に前倒しされていた海外からのクリスマス関連受注が１０月になって落ち着いたため。国慶節の大型連休中に増加した個人消費も、連休明けには勢いを失い、長期の低迷状態に戻ったことが響いた。

中国物流購買連合会のアナリスト張立群氏は「需要不足が景気への下押し圧力を強めている」と指摘。政策当局はこの問題を深刻に受け止め、できるだけ早く対策を強化すべきだと述べた。

新規受注指数と新規輸出受注指数はいずれも縮小圏にとどまった。生産と購買活動も拡大から縮小に転じた。

ピンポイント・アセット・マネジメントのチーフエコノミスト張智威氏は、２０２７年に外需が弱まれば「中国は内需を押し上げるため、より大規模な政策支援が必要になる」と述べた。

東呉証券のチーフエコノミスト、ルー・ジャー氏は「家計の信頼感を支え、心理を安定させるため」、住宅ローン利払いへの補助拡充が必要だとした。また、利払いへの補助を投資事業にも広げれば、採算の見込める固定資産投資案件が不足している現状の緩和につながるとの見方を示した。

サービス業と建設業を対象とする非製造業ＰＭＩも４９．７と、９月の５０．２から低下した。

ＰＭＩは、新規受注や生産、雇用などの状況が前月と比べて改善したか、悪化したか、変わらなかったかについて、購買担当者の回答を基に算出する。５０を上回ると活動の拡大、下回ると縮小を示す。

製造業の一部業種は好調だった。鉄道、造船、航空宇宙機器やコンピューター・通信・電子機器の製造業では、生産指数と新規受注指数がいずれも５３．０以上となった。

特に人工知能（ＡＩ）関連企業は大幅な増益を報告している。ＡＩデータセンターでサーバーとスイッチを接続する高速光モジュールを製造する中際旭創（ジョンジー・イノライト）は、第３・四半期の純利益が約３倍となった。

一方、国内市場の低迷とコスト上昇は、多くの従来型の製造業や不動産関連企業の重しとなっている。オーダーメード家具メーカーの欧派家居（オッペイン・ホーム）は、同期の純利益が８０％減少した。

ただ、中国経済は第３・四半期の成長率が４．５％と、４─６月期の４．３％から持ち直したことから、追加の景気刺激策なしでも年間４．５─５．０％の成長目標を達成する見通しだ。

items.title: ＮＢＡ＝八村が復帰戦で12得点、クリッパーズは黒星　ＮＢＡカップ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［３０日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［３０日　ロイター］ - 米プロバスケットボール協会（ＮＢＡ）は３０日、シーズン中のトーナメント戦であるＮＢＡカップを各地で行い、八村塁が所属する西カンファレンスＢ組のクリッパーズはティンバーウルブズに１０１─１２７で敗れて黒星発進となった。

左太ももの痛みで２８日のレーカーズ戦を欠場していた八村が先発で復帰。２６分２２秒の出場で３点シュート２本を含む１２得点、５リバウンド、２スチールを記録した。クリッパーズはダリアス・ガーランドがチーム最多の２４得点をマーク。チームはターンオーバー数で相手の１１回に対して１７回を記録し、公式戦４連敗となった。

Ａ組では、マーベリックスがロケッツに１１６─１１１で競り勝った。カイリー・アービングが３５得点、クーパー・フラッグが３３得点とチームをけん引した。

東カンファレンスでは、Ｂ組のセブンティシクサーズが昨季王者のニックスに９８─９３で競り勝った。タイリース・マクシーがチーム最多の２７得点に、先発したレブロン・ジェームズも２０得点、９リバウンド、８アシストと存在感を示した。

Ａ組では、マジックがラプターズに１２１─１１４で勝利。ピストンズはネッツを１１０─９４で下した。Ｃ組のセルティックスはブルズに１２５─１１１で快勝した。

items.title: Govt to meet liquor firms as bulk Scotch tariff row threatens UK trade pact
items.summary: In the first major dispute linked to a historic India-UK trade pact implemented in July, New Delhi has told major companies that bulk Scotch imports are not eligible for the tariff reduction to 75 ...
items.body:
Home / Economy / News / Govt to meet liquor firms as bulk Scotch tariff row threatens UK trade pact

Govt to meet liquor firms as bulk Scotch tariff row threatens UK trade pact The ministry did not immediately respond to a request for comment outside regular business hours on Saturday

Representative image from file.

Reuters NEW DELHI, Oct 31 3 min read Last Updated : Oct 31 2026 | 3:15 PM IST

Listen to This Article

India's government will hold talks with liquor companies on Monday after domestic firms joined Diageo and Pernod in expressing alarm about a federal investigation into bulk Scotch imports, according to four sources and an industry letter.
In the first major dispute linked to a historic India-UK trade pact implemented in July, New Delhi has told major companies that bulk Scotch imports are not eligible for the tariff reduction to 75 per cent from 150 per cent agreed in the deal.
The International Spirits & Wines Association of India, a group representing Pernod and Diageo, has privately warned New Delhi that the move to exclude bulk Scotch imports could undermine the pact.
 

The Confederation of Indian Alcoholic Beverage Companies (CIABC) has now joined the protest by flagging a hit to domestic manufacturing, according to an October 27 confidential letter to the government that Reuters is reporting for the first time.
Around 80 per cent of Scotch whisky imports from Britain by volume arrive in bulk to be used to make popular brands, and India's $65 billion alcohol industry had hoped the cut in tariffs would bolster business.
Also Read

UK opens 3 new 'legal' refugee resettlement routes for India, other nations

UK minister calls for speedier India-UK healthcare innovation, adoption

United Spirits reports Q2 profit of ₹462 cr, revenue at ₹7,001 cr

India's Scotch probe of Diageo, Pernod undermines UK pact benefits: ISWAI

Tax dept probes Pernod, Diageo Scotch imports under UK trade pact

Top Indian commerce ministry officials will on Monday hold closed-door talks with several senior executives of foreign and domestic liquor companies to discuss the issue, said the four people who have direct knowledge of the meeting.

The ministry did not immediately respond to a request for comment outside regular business hours on Saturday.
Britain has said it is working with India on the issue, and Scottish government has raised the treatment of bulk Scotch with New Delhi, Reuters has reported. India has not commented on the matter.
Whisky tariffs were a sticking point during years of protracted negotiations on a UK-India free trade deal, though India, a whisky-loving nation, ultimately agreed to halve taxes on certain Scotch imports.
INDIAN PEERS SEEK URGENT INTERVENTION The CIABC's letter said that if bulk Scotch used in Indian manufacturing was not eligible for the lower tariff, "this could create an unintended incentive in favour of importing finished products."

"Such an outcome would run counter to the objective of strengthening domestic manufacturing under Make in India," it added, seeking urgent intervention to avoid disruptions.
The group's members include listed Indian majors Radico Khaitan, maker of the 8PM brand, and Allied Blenders and Distillers, maker of Officer's Choice. CIABC and the companies did not respond to queries. All firms have said they comply with the law.
Allied Blenders said in an investor presentation this week it is "one of the largest bulk Scotch importers" and the UK pact would improve its "luxury portfolio accessibility".
Import tariff disputes have long been a sore point for foreign investors in India who have faced demands for large amounts of back tax. Indian officials say they are only enforcing the law of the land.

(Only the headline and picture of this report may have been reworked by the Business Standard staff; the rest of the content is auto-generated from a syndicated feed.)

items.title: サッカー＝プリシッチ、ミランと新契約を締結　31年まで
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［３０日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［３０日　ロイター］ - サッカーのイタリア・セリエＡ、ＡＣミランは３０日、米国代表ＭＦクリスティアン・プリシッチ（２８）と２０３１年までの新契約を締結したと発表した。

２３年にミラン入りしたプリシッチは、同クラブで通算１４１試合に出場し、４４ゴール２８アシストを記録。２７年６月までとなっていた契約を延長し、３０年ワールドカップ（Ｗ杯）以降もミランでプレーすることになった。

プリシッチはクラブ公式の交流サイトを通じて、「ミランは私に全てを与えてくれた。ここは自分の家のようだ。このクラブを心から愛している」と述べた。

これまでチェルシー（イングランド）やドルトムント（ドイツ）でプレーした経験を持つプリシッチは、米国代表として９０試合に出場して３３得点を記録。２２年Ｗ杯と２６年Ｗ杯にも出場し、米国サッカー連盟が選出する年間最優秀男子選手賞を過去４回受賞している。

items.title: France's credit outlook splits rating agencies: Fitch turns negative, Moody’s stays stable, bond risk sees biggest drop
items.author: Bobins Vayalil Abraham
items.summary: Fitch warned that France’s debt outlook is worsening, projecting debt to reach 124% of GDP by 2028 amid weak growth. Moody’s kept its Aa3 rating unchanged. Despite a recent rally that narrowed the French-German bond spread, fiscal concerns and budget challenges persist.
items.body:
Credit ratings agency Fitch on Friday revised France's outlook to "negative" from "stable", warning that deteriorating fiscal conditions and political fragmentation are undermining debt stabilization prospects.The agency pointed to weaker growth, higher borrowing costs and a wider deficit since its August review, compounded by a fractured political landscape that is making sustained fiscal consolidation harder to deliver.Why Fitch downgraded France's outlookFitch predicted that the debt level for the European Union's second biggest economy would rise from nearly 115.7 percent of GDP in 2025 to 124 percent in 2028. In its last review in August, Fitch had forecast that France's debt would reach 122.7 percent of GDP in 2028. "Weaker growth, renewed fiscal deterioration and higher yields have increased the challenge of delivering the necessary sustained fiscal consolidation to arrest France's worsening debt trajectory," Fitch said.According to Fitch’s outlook, the prospects for debt reduction after the presidential election in April-May next year were "uncertain".It said the political divisions, with far-right and far-left candidates leading opinion poll surveys, would make it difficult to agree "a credible fiscal strategy"."The emerging policy debate ahead of the presidential election has not materially strengthened Fitch's confidence in the prospects for durable deficit reduction that could lead to debt stabilization. Large protests over public services and living costs further complicate the social context for fiscal consolidation," it said. International investors have expressed widespread concern over France's debt level and this has pushed up the interest yields it pays to service debt, which is one of the highest in Europe.
The outlook revision adds to pressure on the government ahead of more planned protests this weekend, underscoring the political challenges of implementing spending cuts and deficit-reduction measures.
French bond risk falls
French 10-year yields hit their highest since 2002 last week at more than 5.14%, rising more sharply than those of most peers, reflecting greater sensitivity to shifts in market confidence amid concerns over France's fiscal trajectory, struggle to pass a budget and social unrest.
Earlier, the INSEE national statistics agency reported Friday that the economy has not grown so far this year and contracted in the period from July to September.
Meanwhile, France on Friday managed to avoid another rating downgrade, this time by Moody’s. Moody’s kept France’s rating steady at Aa3 with a negative outlook. The following markets rally has led to French bond risk being poised for its biggest drop since the 2020 pandemic. According to Bloomberg, the extra yield investors demand to hold 10-year French bonds, known as OATs, over safer German debt fell 13 basis points to 154 basis points on Monday, the largest drop in six years on a closing basis.

SANTA SUSANNA, Spain, Oct 30 : Nonagenarian Japanese bodybuilder Toshisuke Kanazawa took to the stage on Spain's Costa del Maresme on Friday, aiming to prove that age is no barrier to peak physical fitness.
The 90-year-old travelled to the coastal town of Santa Susanna to compete against rivals decades his junior in the masters category for athletes aged 50 and older in a competition held by the International Fitness and Bodybuilding Federation.
Backstage, Kanazawa mirrored the preparations of younger competitors, warming up with his team and applying spray tan before flexing under the stage lights.
"I like to try doing things that nobody else has done, and more than anything I want to pursue bodybuilding for the rest of my life," Kanazawa said.

Kanazawa credits his longevity and conditioning to strict dietary habits, saying that a routine established decades ago has kept him robust.
"This is something I've been researching and want to learn more about. But ever since I turned 50, I've been building muscle by eating a purely Japanese diet: brown rice, natto (a fermented soya bean dish)), and miso soup," he said.
"It's really the classic Japanese way of eating. And thanks to that, I've gone 90 years without ever getting sick."
Though he did not finish on the podium, Kanazawa remains focused on pushing the sport's boundaries, outlining plans for one final appearance before stepping away from competition.
"I'm thinking I might give it one more go at 93. After that, I'll probably have to retire," he said.
"As you get older, you start developing wrinkles, quite a lot of them. In Japan, there's this idea that once you get those wrinkles, it just doesn't look very good anymore."
Ultimately, Kanazawa hopes his perseverance inspires older generations to remain active and challenge conventional limits.
"Once you set your mind to something, you need to develop the mental strength and determination to see it through no matter what," Kanazawa said.
"I want people to work hard just as I have. I believe that if they do, we'll see more people like me even as they get older. That's what I hope for, and I want to be a good role model."

items.title: 習主席、訪中のドイツ大統領と会談　友好的な貿易政策要請
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Mei Mei Chu　Liz Lee

[北京 ３０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Mei Mei Chu　Liz Lee

[北京 ３０日 ロイター] - 中国の習近平国家主席は３０日、ドイツのシュタインマイヤー大統領と北京で会談し、「理性的で実務的かつ友好的」な対中政策を取るよう求めた。欧州との貿易摩擦が強まる中、平等や互恵、戦略的安定に基づく「全方位的な戦略パートナーシップ」を支持する考えを示した。

習氏は「この新たな関係のあり方は、われわれが閉鎖よりも開放を、対立よりも協力を支持するという前向きなシグナルを世界に送るものだ」とシュタインマイヤー氏に語った。 

シュタインマイヤー氏は欧州連合（ＥＵ）が拡大する対中貿易赤字への対応を強める中、５日間の日程で中国を訪問。前日には、中国の経済的自立に向けた取り組みが他の市場を犠牲にしてはならないと警告していた。独仏は、ＥＵに損害を与える国に迅速に対抗する新措置を提案し、中国を念頭に置いているとみられる。

中国はスイスとの自由貿易協定改定やアイスランドとの航空路線新設など、欧州への外交攻勢を展開している。ただ、ＳＯＡＳ中国研究所のスティーブ・ツァン所長は、自国の経済利益を優先する中国の姿勢に対する懸念を和らげる効果は限定的と指摘。従来、中国との緊密な経済関係を推進してきたドイツ産業界からも、対中政策の厳格化を求める声が強まっていると述べた。

[３０日 ロイター] - 英紙フィナンシャル・タイムズ（ＦＴ）は３０日、米人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業オープンＡＩが最新の資金調達ラウンドの目標額を１００億ドル引き下げ、企業評価額１兆２５００億ドルで２００億ドルの調達を目指していると報じた。事情に詳しい関係者の話として伝えた。

対話型ＡＩ「チャットＧＰＴ」を手がける同社は当初、企業評価額１兆４０００億ドルで３００億ドルを調達する計画だった。ロイターは先週、競合するアンソロピックが１１月中旬に予定する株式上場を前に、オープンＡＩが投資家の出資取り付けを急いでいると報じていた。

ＦＴによると、オープンＡＩは投資家が出資を確約する期限を３０日に設定した。ただ、一部の投資家が出資額を減らしたため、第１段階の調達額は２００億ドルを下回る見通しだという。

オープンＡＩからコメントは得られていない。

ＡＩへの巨額支出に対する懸念の高まりを受け、３０日の米国株式市場では米ハイテク株が急落。ナスダック総合指数は２．９％安となり、１０月６日に付けた終値ベースの最高値から７．８％下落している。

items.title: Ｆ１＝メキシコＧＰフリー走行、ルクレール最速　岩佐と平川が参加
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［メキシコ市　３０日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［メキシコ市　３０日　ロイター］ - 自動車レースＦ１の今季第１９戦、メキシコ・グランプリ（ＧＰ）は３０日、メキシコ市でフリー走行を行い、フェラーリのシャルル・ルクレール（モナコ）がこの日のトップタイムを記録した。

フリー走行１回目に最速１分１８秒１２８を記録したルクレールは、２回目でトップタイムの１分１７秒８２７をマークした。

２９日のメディア対応を体調不良のため欠席していたメルセデスのキミ・アントネッリ（イタリア）は１回目で２番手、２回目で４番手だった。個人総合でチームメートのジョージ・ラッセル（英国）に１２３点差をつけて首位に立つアントネッリは、今回のメキシコＧＰで９位以内に入ればＦ１史上最年少王者となる。

マクラーレンのランド・ノリス（英国）は２回目でルクレールと０秒１０３差の２番手。ラッセルは３番手だった。

残り４７分には、レッドブルのマックス・フェルスタッペン（オランダ）とレーシングブルズのリアム・ローソン（ニュージーランド）が接触。フェルスタッペンのマシンの破片がコース上に散乱し、赤旗で一時中断となった。

フェラーリのルイス・ハミルトン（英国）は残り３０分でマシンをコース上にストップさせ、バーチャル・セーフティーカーが導入。ハミルトンは無線で「完全にパワーを失った」と報告した。

また、１回目には岩佐歩夢（レッドブル）、平川亮（ハース）の日本人ドライバーが参加し、それぞれ５番手の１分１９秒１１３、１５番手の１分１９秒９８２のタイムを残した。

items.title: ＮＢＡ＝モラントが左太もも裏負傷、最低4週間離脱へ　古巣戦で負傷
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［３０日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［３０日　ロイター］ - 米プロバスケットボール協会（ＮＢＡ）のトレイルブレーザーズは３０日、ガードのジャ・モラント（２７）が左太もも裏の肉離れで最低４週間離脱すると発表した。

モラントは２９日に行われた古巣グリズリーズとの試合で負傷。ＭＲＩ検査の結果、グレード２の肉離れが判明した。４週間後に再検査を受ける予定という。

モラントは第４クオーターで途中退場。この試合では２３分間の出場で１４得点、３アシストを記録した。トレイルブレーザーズは１０３─１２４で敗れ、開幕からの連勝が３で止まった。

今季からトレイルブレーザーズでプレーするモラントは、ここまで４試合に出場し、１試合平均１５．８得点、５．５アシストを記録している。

モラントは２０１９年のドラフト全体２位でグリズリーズに入団。１９─２０年シーズンに新人王、２１─２２年シーズンには最も成長を見せた選手に贈られる賞を受賞し、オールスターにも２回選出された。

一方、けがや銃に関連した問題による出場停止処分などもあった。６月２９日にトレードでトレイルブレーザーズへ移籍した。

items.title: 再送Ｇ２０外相会合、ロシア参加に欧州反発　米長官は協力促す
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
(見出しを修正しました)

Andrea Shalal

[アトランタ（米ジョージア州） ３０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
(見出しを修正しました)

Andrea Shalal

[アトランタ（米ジョージア州） ３０日 ロイター] - ２０カ国・地域（Ｇ２０）外相会合が３０日、米ジョージア州アトランタで開幕した。ルビオ米国務長官は、地政学的な安定と経済的繁栄の拡大に向けた協力を呼びかけ、一連の危機が世界の経済秩序を脅かしていると警告した。 

ただ、ルビオ氏の招待によるロシアのラブロフ外相の参加に多くの外相が反発し、ウクライナと中東の戦争を巡る溝が深まった。会合は共同宣言を採択せず、議長声明を発表して閉幕する見通しだ。

英国のミリバンド外相はラブロフ氏に直接、ロシアの無人機攻撃で前日に１５人が死亡したと指摘し、「あなた方が侵略者であることは、われわれ全員が分かっている」と非難。ラブロフ氏は、ウクライナがロシアの安全保障上の脅威となることは容認できないと述べた。

欧州側がラブロフ氏との写真撮影を拒んだため、恒例の集合写真は見送られた。西側外交官によると、豪州やカナダを含むメンバーの３分の１が撮影に反対した。

また西側当局者らによると、中東の戦争がもたらす経済的課題の深刻さについては、おおむね認識が一致。多くの出席者は、米国によるイラン攻撃が再開すれば、原油価格が急騰して打撃が深まると懸念を示した。

外相らは３１日、供給網（サプライチェーン）や重要鉱物の調達について協議する予定。米中の戦略的競争も合意形成を難しくしている。１２月１４─１６日にマイアミで開く首脳会議での共同宣言採択に向け、調整が続く。

欧州連合（ＥＵ）のカラス外交安全保障上級代表は、ウクライナ支援拡大とロシアの責任追及を求める考えを示した。

items.title: ゴルフ＝山下が単独首位浮上、メイバンク選手権で連覇へ前進
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［３０日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［３０日　ロイター］ - 米女子ゴルフのメイバンク選手権は３０日、マレーシアのクアラルンプール・クラブ（パー７２）で第２ラウンドを行い、昨年覇者の山下美夢有が単独首位に浮上した。

２位スタートの山下美夢有は６バーディー、ノーボギーの６６をマークし、通算１３アンダーの１３１とした。２位勢に２打差をつけ、２連覇と米ツアー今季３勝目に向けて好位置につけた。

前日２１位で出た吉田優利は７０、同１２位の岩井明愛は７１で回り、ともに通算５アンダーの２３位となった。そのほかの日本勢は、勝みなみが３９位、岩井千怜と渋野日向子が４６位、原英莉花と古江彩佳が５３位だった。

首位で出たポーリーヌ・ルサンブシャール（フランス）は６９で回り、通算１１アンダーの２位。

items.title: ＭＬＢ＝マーリンズ、元サイ・ヤング賞アルカンタラの契約オプション行使
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［３０日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［３０日　ロイター］ - 米大リーグ（ＭＬＢ）のマーリンズは３０日、サンディ・アルカンタラ投手（３１）との契約に関し、２０２７年年俸２１００万ドル（約３３億円）の球団オプションを行使した。

マーリンズがオプションを行使しない場合、２００万ドルの契約解除金を支払う必要があった。

アルカンタラは今季３６試合（先発３３試合）に登板し、１３勝１１敗３セーブ、防御率３．８７、１５３三振を記録。投球回２１４はメジャー最多だった。

マーリンズのピーター・ベンディックス編成本部長はシーズン終了時の記者会見で、「サンディは球団にとって非常に大きな存在。今季も素晴らしいシーズンだった」と称賛。さらに、チーム内でのリーダーシップや模範的な振る舞いについて「他に並ぶものがない」と高く評価した。

アルカンタラは１７年にカージナルスでメジャーデビューし、通算２１３試合（先発２０２試合）に登板して６５勝７８敗、防御率３．６９。２２年にナ・リーグのサイ・ヤング賞（最優秀投手賞）を受賞したが、右肘のトミー・ジョン手術により２４年シーズンを全休した。

items.title: サッカー＝ルアーブル瀬古と中村先発もＰＳＧに大敗、マインツ佐野は終盤までプレー
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［３０日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［３０日　ロイター］ - サッカーのフランス１部は３０日、各地でリーグ戦を行い、瀬古歩夢と中村草太が先発したルアーブルはホームのパリ・サンジェルマン戦に１─５で大敗した。

前半１８分に先制したルアーブルだが、同２６分に追いつかれると、その後アクラフ・ハキミにハットトリックを許すなどさらに４失点して大敗した。瀬古はフル出場、中村は後半２０分までプレーした。チームメートの水多海斗はベンチスタートから出番がなかった。

上田綺世が所属するリールはホームにＲＣランスを迎え、後半４１分にオリビエ・ジルーが決勝点を記録し、１─０で勝利。負傷中の上田はメンバー外だった。

ドイツ１部ブンデスリーガでは、マインツの佐野海舟が敵地のエルファースベルク戦で先発し、後半４２分までプレー。チームは１─４で敗れた。

FAST

Oct 30 : Crypto exchanges are taking quick action to bolster their defenses and urging greater industry-wide information-sharing after a record $6.3 billion hack of Binance exposed their vulnerability just as they become more embedded in mainstream finance.
Coinbase said it made adjustments to its systems that store cryptocurrency keys offline "solely out of an abundance of caution," while Kraken said it was monitoring industry incidents for lessons it could apply to its defenses.
But the industry will need to move urgently, analysts and industry executives said, as President Donald Trump's regulators promote deeper integration of digital assets into the financial system, raising the stakes for an industry with a history of big hacks.
"For crypto to reach its full potential, the security situation must be addressed immediately," said Chris Perkins, Franklin Templeton's head of crypto.

Binance, the world's largest crypto exchange, halted withdrawals after Thursday's attack — which analysts blamed on North Korea — and said it would use company funds to cover the losses.
Binance co-CEO Richard Teng said on X that the “complex attack” may have begun with a compromised software engineer’s laptop, giving hackers access to systems used to process withdrawals. The company later found additional breaches, while software designed to erase traces of the attack hampered the investigation.
Rival crypto exchanges moved quickly on Friday to shore up their own systems and to reassure customers that their tokens were safe
“Full-time teams at Kraken look for potential vulnerabilities every day,” a Kraken spokesperson said.
Still, even as the industry reeled from the biggest cryptocurrency heist of all time, executives expressed confidence that Binance had sufficient resources to cover the losses and that the hack would not have broader financial repercussions.
Bitcoin fell more than 4 per cent on Thursday while ether, the second-largest cryptocurrency, fell more than 5 per cent, although both tokens recovered some of that ground on Friday.
"Our expectation is the industry writ large will actually not suffer material losses, even though Binance is obviously going to have to deal with the exploit directly," said Josh Riezman, chief legal and strategy officer at crypto firm GSR.
The bulk of the heist unfolded in around 20 minutes late on Thursday and bore similarities to previous attacks blamed on North Korea, according to US blockchain analysis firms TRM Labs and Chainalysis.
North Korea routinely denies involvement in cryptocurrency thefts, and its mission in Geneva did not respond to requests for comment.
HACK INVOLVES SOCIAL ENGINEERING, MONEY LAUNDERING
While much remains unclear, social engineering, a common tactic in which hackers trick victims into revealing sensitive information or granting access to systems, may have been involved in compromising the laptop, security experts said.
Harry Donnelly, CEO of Circuit, a crypto risk infrastructure company, said companies are planning more employee training to guard against social engineering attacks.
In such attacks, hackers race to launder the funds before the exchange detects the breach and token issuers freeze assets. Stablecoin issuer Tether said it had frozen nearly $1.57 billion linked to Binance, while Circle said it froze $800 million. Bitcoin and ether cannot be frozen because no single entity controls the coins.
Chainalysis said the hackers appeared to be using sophisticated laundering patterns it had not seen before.
On Friday, some crypto exchange executives called for the industry to develop a coordinated hack detection system.
"We need a real-time alert system that allows participants to share information immediately when a hack occurs, coordinate a rapid response, and temporarily freeze suspected stolen funds," said Star Xu, CEO of crypto exchange OKX, in a post on X.
GSR's Riezman added that the Binance hack could spur the industry to act: "As we're at this kind of confluence moment for traditional finance and digital assets, I think it's obviously important that we continue to improve, and I think this, if anything, will be a catalyst for that."

Source: Reuters

Oct 30 : OpenAI has slashed the target for its latest funding round by $10 billion amid a selloff in tech stocks driven by AI worries, the Financial Times reported on Friday, citing people with knowledge of the matter.
The ChatGPT maker is now seeking about $20 billion and its desired valuation has dropped to $1.25 trillion from $1.4 billion, the report said.
OpenAI set a Friday deadline for investors to commit to the funding round, but the "first close" is expected to raise less than $20 billion after some investors reduced their allocations, it added.
A consortium of UAE investors that includes state-backed technology fund MGX is expected to be the largest participant in the round, and as part of the deal, OpenAI would gain the option to lease newly developed computing capacity in the region, the newspaper added.

Venture capital firms including Founders Fund, Coatue, Sequoia Capital and Andreessen Horowitz are also expected to participate, according to the report.
Wealthy individuals will have the option to invest in a subsequent retail offering at a $1.25 trillion valuation, the FT added.
OpenAI, MGX, Coatue, Sequoia Capital and Andreessen Horowitz did not immediately respond to Reuters requests for comment outside regular business hours. Founders Fund could not be reached for comment.
US tech stocks have suffered a rout amid growing worries over massive spending on AI. The tech-heavy Nasdaq index dropped 2.9 per cent on Friday and is down 7.8 per cent from its all-time closing high reached on October 6.
OpenAI, which is pursuing a listing in 2027, has been keen to close the funding round partly to get ahead of Anthropic's imminent listing as the two are tapping a similar investor base, Reuters has reported.

items.title: トランプ氏「北朝鮮の関与調査」、バイナンスの暗号資産流出巡り
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Lawrence Delevingne　Summer Zhen　Elizabeth Howcroft

[ボストン／シンガポール／パリ ３０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Lawrence Delevingne　Summer Zhen　Elizabeth Howcroft

[ボストン／シンガポール／パリ ３０日 ロイター] - 世界最大の暗号資産（仮想通貨）交換業者バイナンスがサイバー攻撃を受けて６３億ドル相当の資産が流出した事件で、トランプ米大統領は３０日、北朝鮮のハッカーが関与したかは分からないとした上で、政権として調査していると述べた。

アナリストは北朝鮮が事件に関与していると分析しており、金融資産の窃盗事件として史上最大となる可能性を指摘した。

トランプ氏は、盗まれた資金を一部でも回収できると思うかと記者団に問われ、「ハッキングだった。それが問題だ。昔は小切手に署名してお金を引き出したものだが、これは違う」と指摘。一方、「ただ、バイナンスは状況をほぼ掌握していると言っている」と述べた。

関係者によると、バイナンスは米連邦捜査局（ＦＢＩ）や米シークレットサービス（ＵＳＳＳ）に協力している。

ＦＢＩは「事件を認識しており、活動の範囲を把握し、潜在的な影響を評価し、適切な捜査手続きを調整するため、関係する官民の協力先と連携している」と表明した。

ＵＳＳＳは、捜査関係者が「民間の協力企業と２４時間態勢で連携し、２９日にバイナンスから盗まれた資金の特定、凍結、追跡、回収に取り組んでいる」と説明した。

ステーブルコイン発行会社テザーは、事件に関連する約１５億７０００万ドルの資産を凍結したと発表。サークルは８億ドル超を凍結した。

バイナンスに主要な営業免許を交付したアブダビ金融サービス規制庁は「バイナンスと緊密に連携し、事件を注視している」と表明した。

items.title: テニス＝ズベレフ圧勝、アルカラスも4強入り　エルステバンクＯＰ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［３０日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［３０日　ロイター］ - 男子テニスのエルステバンク・オープン（ＯＰ）は３０日、オーストリアのウィーンでシングルス準々決勝を行い、第１シードのアレクサンダー・ズベレフ（ドイツ）と第２シードのカルロス・アルカラス（スペイン）らが４強入りを決めた。

全仏ＯＰと全米ＯＰを制したズベレフは、アーサー・フェリー（英国）に６─０、６─２で圧勝。わずか５８分で試合を終えた。フェリーは前日の２回戦で理学療法士の治療を受けており、この日も序盤から身体に問題を抱えている様子だった。

ズベレフは２９日の勝利で自身初の世界ランキング１位浮上を確定させており、１１月２日付のランキングで史上３０人目のトップに立つ。

アルカラスは第７シードのトミー・ポール（米国）と対戦し、６─４、７─６のストレート勝ち。第２セットはタイブレークを７─２で制して勝利を決めた。

ロシア出身で第３シードのダニル・メドベージェフは、アドリアン・マナリノ（フランス）を６─２、６─３で退けた。メドベージェフはこれで、シーズン最終戦のＡＴＰファイナルに２年ぶり７回目の出場が決定。今季は２０２３年以来となるシーズン５０勝を突破している。

第５シードのアレックス・デミノー（オーストラリア）はマテオ・ベレッティーニ（イタリア）を７─６、６─２で下した。

items.title: ＭＬＢ＝西武が平良のメジャー挑戦容認、パの最優秀防御率
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［３０日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［３０日　ロイター］ - プロ野球（ＮＰＢ）の西武は３０日、平良海馬投手（２６）がポスティングシステムを利用して米大リーグ（ＭＬＢ）への移籍を目指すことを容認したと発表した。

平良は今季、先発に復帰して２３試合に登板し、１２勝５敗、防御率１．３６、１４１三振を記録。パ・リーグの最優秀防御率のタイトルを獲得した。昨季は救援として３１セーブ、防御率１．７１をマーク。通算では３２５試合に登板し、防御率１．７８、６２０三振の成績を残している。

平良は球団を通じ「長い間、メジャーでプレーしたいという思いを持っていたので、ようやくそこに一歩踏み出せたと感じている」とコメント。西武の広池浩司球団本部長は「私の中では、間違いなくＮＰＢナンバーワンの投手」と高く評価した。

ＭＬＢ公式サイトは平良について、時速１５０キロ台半ばから後半の速球に加え、カットボール、スイーパー、チェンジアップ、スプリットなど多彩な変化球を操ると紹介。今オフの移籍市場では、サイ・ヤング賞（最優秀投手賞）２回のタリク・スクバル投手に次ぐ球威と変化球の質を持つと評価している。

一方、ＭＬＢ球団は平良を救援投手として評価する可能性もあり、先発起用への意向が移籍先の選択に影響する可能性がある。

西武が正式にポスティング申請を行えば、ＭＬＢ全３０球団との交渉期間は４５日間となる。契約年数や金額に制限はなく、移籍が成立すれば西武には契約額に応じた譲渡金が支払われる。

今オフは阪神の佐藤輝明内野手もポスティングシステムによるＭＬＢ移籍を目指している。

items.title: 茂木外相、邦人記者の即時解放要求　ラブロフ外相と米で会談
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [アトランタ（米ジョージア州） ３０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[アトランタ（米ジョージア州） ３０日 ロイター] - 茂木敏充外相は３０日、米アトランタで開かれた２０カ国・地域（Ｇ２０）外相会合に合わせてロシアのラブロフ外相と会談し、同国サハリン州でロシア当局に拘束された北海道新聞記者の解放を求めた。

ウクライナ情勢や長年の領土問題を巡って関係が緊張する中、日ロ高官が会談を開くのは異例。

外務省は声明で「茂木大臣から現下の日ロ間の諸問題等に関し、日本政府の立場に基づいて、申入れや主張を行った」とした上で「サハリン州における邦人拘束の件については、茂木大臣から即時解放を強く求めた」と説明した。

ロシアは今月１３日、極東サハリン州で日本人記者をスパイ容疑で拘束したと発表していた。

また声明は、茂木氏が「ウクライナにおける公正かつ永続的な平和の実現のため、ロシアが前向きな対応をとることを改めて強く求めた」とし、両大臣は「日ロ関係が厳しい状況にある中でも、意思疎通をしていくことにした」と述べた。 

インタファクス通信はロシア外務省の発表として、日本側の要請で「ラブロフ外相と茂木外相による短時間の会談」が行われたと報じた。

同省は「ロシア側は、本格的な国家間対話の再開には、日本政府が非友好的な政策を放棄する必要があると強調した」とした。

これに先立ち、アトランタでのＧ２０外相会合では、ウクライナでの戦争を理由に欧州の代表がロシアの参加に異議を唱えたため、恒例の会合前の集合写真撮影が見送られた。

items.title: Trump Can Drive Turnout on Both Sides: Taylor
items.summary: Jessica Taylor, Senate and Governors editor for The Cook Political Report, says President Donald Trump is needed on the campaign trail to drive Republican turnout, but making the midterms about himself could also motivate Democrats and independents to vote against his party. Taylor says Cook moved Florida's Senate race from Solid Republican to Likely Republican because it expects a single-digit contest and says Florida could offer an early indication of how Republicans are performing nationally. Taylor says some states could produce different results in their gubernatorial and Senate races and that the bigger question in the closing days is which voters ultimately turn out. She speaks with Joe Mathieu and Kailey Leinz on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: 英裁判所、メタなどＳＮＳ3社の異議退ける　情報提供要請巡り
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ロンドン ３０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ロンドン ３０日 ロイター] - 英国で段階的に導入されている「オンライン安全法」に基づく、英メディア規制当局、情報通信庁（オフコム）からの情報提供要請を巡るメタ・プラットフォームズなど大手交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）３社の異議申し立てについて、ロンドンの高等法院は３０日、退ける判断を下した。

「安全法」では、有害で違法なコンテンツから主に子どもを保護するため、メタが運営するフェイスブックやインスタグラムといったプラットフォーム事業者に厳しい基準を定めている。違反企業に対して世界の年間売上高の最大１０％に相当する制裁金が科される。

オフコムは今年２月、メタや中国系短編動画投稿アプリ「ＴｉｋＴｏｋ（ティックトック）」、「Ｘ」の３社に対し、削除や表示制限された投稿の数、有害コンテンツにさらされた利用者数などコンテンツ管理の詳細の提供を要請。各社は、前例のない規制上の負担をもたらすと主張。Ｘは数百万ポンドの費用がかかると主張していた。

オフコムの報道官は今回の判断を歓迎し、「企業からの情報収集は職務を遂行する上で基礎となるものだ」と指摘した。メタの広報担当は声明で、これほどの規模の情報収集は必要で均衡のとれた範囲を超えているため、異議申し立てを行ったと主張した。

判決は、オフコムにとって追い風となるものの、メタからは手数料や制裁金に関する別の案件も提起されている。

items.title: ＮＹ市場サマリー（30日）円3日続伸、株急落　利回り低下
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
＜為替＞　円が３日続伸。日銀が政策金利を据え置き、物価見通しを引き上げたことが材料となったほか、米国債利回りの低下もドルの重しとなった。 

日銀は３０日、金融政策決定会合で金利の据え置きを決定した。ただ、金融政策はよりタカ派的な新たな局面に入ったと強調し、数カ月に１度のペースでの利上げに踏み切る可能性を示唆した。 

円は対ドルで０．１１％高の１ドル＝１５７．５１円。ただ、月間では下落する見通しとなった。

主要通貨に対するドル指数は横ばいの１０１．８８。月間では２カ月続伸となる見通し。 

ユーロは０．１２％安の１．１１６８ドル。月間では２カ月続落となる見通し。

来週はイングランド銀行（英中央銀行）とオーストラリア準備銀行（中央銀行）の金融政策決定会合が注目される。 

英ポンドは０．１５％高の１．３３９６ドル。豪ドルは対米ドルで０．０９％高の０．７０３４５米ドル。いずれも月間ベースで上昇する勢いとなっている。

＜為替＞　円が３日続伸。日銀が政策金利を据え置き、物価見通しを引き上げたことが材料となったほか、米国債利回りの低下もドルの重しとなった。 

日銀は３０日、金融政策決定会合で金利の据え置きを決定した。ただ、金融政策はよりタカ派的な新たな局面に入ったと強調し、数カ月に１度のペースでの利上げに踏み切る可能性を示唆した。 

円は対ドルで０．１１％高の１ドル＝１５７．５１円。ただ、月間では下落する見通しとなった。

主要通貨に対するドル指数は横ばいの１０１．８８。月間では２カ月続伸となる見通し。 

ユーロは０．１２％安の１．１１６８ドル。月間では２カ月続落となる見通し。

来週はイングランド銀行（英中央銀行）とオーストラリア準備銀行（中央銀行）の金融政策決定会合が注目される。 

英ポンドは０．１５％高の１．３３９６ドル。豪ドルは対米ドルで０．０９％高の０．７０３４５米ドル。いずれも月間ベースで上昇する勢いとなっている。

暗号資産（仮想通貨）のビットコインは２．６１％安の７万６７８０．９３ドル。世界最大の暗号資産（仮想通貨）交換業者バイナンスで、ハッカーの攻撃により６３億ドル相当の資産が流出したことが材料視された。 

ＮＹ外為市場：[USD/J]

＜債券＞　指標となる１０年債利回りの１０月月間の低下幅が３６ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）となり、２３年１２月以来の大きさとなった。週間でも４週連続で低下し、連続低下期間は１年ぶりの長さとなった。

ハイテク関連株の急落で人工知能（ＡＩ）投資への懸念が強まり、安全資産である米国債に資金が流入した。

米１０年債利回りは終盤で６．４ｂｐ低下の４．９２５％。一時は９月半ば以来の低水準を付けた。３０年債利回りは１．９ｂｐ低下の５．３１％で、月間低下幅は同じく２３年１２月以来の大きさとなる見通し。

ＦＲＢの政策金利見通しを反映しやすい２年債利回りは８．１ｂｐ低下の４．５７５％。月間では２０２５年８月以来の大幅低下となる見通し。

経済見通しを示す指標として注目される２年債と１０年債の利回り格差は３４．６ｂｐだった。

物価連動国債（ＴＩＰＳ）と通常の国債の利回り差で、期待インフレを示すブレーク・イーブン・インフレ率（ＢＥＩ）は、５年物が２．４６１％。２９日終盤は２．４６９％だった。１０年物ＴＩＰＳのＢＥＩは２．３３６％だった。 

米金融・債券市場：[US/BJ]

＜株式＞　急落して取引を終えた。ナスダック総合は１日の下落率として６月５日以来の大きさを記録した。２９日に発表されたインテルとアマゾン・ドット・コムの四半期決算が期待外れとなり、人工知能（ＡＩ）関連企業による巨額支出を巡る懸念が一段と強まった。

主要３指数はいずれも大幅に下落。ハイテク株の比率が高いナスダックは２．９％安となった 。

アマゾンは取引が進むにつれて下げ幅を縮めたが、インテル株は２８．６％急落した。 

半導体株は大きく値を下げた。エヌビディアが４．２％安、ＡＭＤが１０．９％安となった。フィラデルフィア半導体指数は７．２％下落し、月間で１５％を超える下げとなった。

サーバー大手のデルとＨＰはそれぞれ１０．８％安、９．６％安だった。 

主要３指数はいずれも週間で下落して取引を終えた。Ｓ＆Ｐ５００とナスダックは月間でも下落したが、ダウは上昇して１０月を終えた。

第３・四半期の決算発表シーズンは折り返し点を過ぎ、Ｓ＆Ｐ５００構成企業のうち２９９社が発表を終えた。ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、このうち８２％が市場予想を上回った。アナリストは現在、Ｓ＆Ｐ５００構成企業の第３・四半期利益が前年同期比３１．６％増加すると予想している。

石油大手エクソンモービルとシェブロンは、ともに四半期利益が市場予想を上回った。エネルギー供給の混乱で利益率が急上昇したことが寄与した。両社株はそれぞれ２．２％高、２．８％高となった。 

コーヒーチェーンのスターバックスは１．８％安。中国事業の売却に伴い、通期売上高が減少するとの見通しを示した。

暗号資産（仮想通貨）関連企業のコインベース、ストラテジー、ロビンフッドは７．２─１０．６％下落した。 世界最大の暗号資産（仮想通貨）交換業者バイナンスで、ハッカーの攻撃により６３億ドル相当の資産が流出したことを受けた。

ニューヨーク証券取引所（ＮＹＳＥ）では値下がり銘柄数が値上がり銘柄数を１．８対１の比率で上回った。ナスダックでは値下がり銘柄数が値上がり銘柄数を３．０３対１の比率で上回った。

米取引所の出来高は１９８億７０００万株で、直近２０営業日の平均１７２億６０００万株を上回った。

米国株式市場：[.NJP]

＜金先物＞　金価格は１年ぶりの安値を付けた。銀、プラチナ、パラジウムも大幅に下落し、テクニカル指標で売られ過ぎの水準に沈んだ。米東部時間午後２時１３分（日本時間３１日午前３時１３分）時点で、金現物は３．５％安の１オンス＝３８８０．９７ドルとなり、２０２５年１０月以来の安値を記録。銀は６．５％安の４９ドルと、１１カ月ぶりに５０ドルを割り込んだ。パラジウムも１０００ドルを下回った。米金先物１２月物の清算値は３．３％安の１オンス＝３８９８．９０ドルだった。

ＮＹ貴金属：[GOL/XJ]

＜米原油先物＞　２％超急騰し、４月末以来の高値で取引を終えた。来週に控える米中間選挙後に、イランとの戦争がさらに激化する可能性に市場が身構える中、ホルムズ海峡でのタンカー攻撃が供給リスクを浮き彫りにした。     清算値は、北海ブレント先物１２月限は２．７６ドル（２．４％）高の１バレル＝１１７．６４ドル。一時、１１８ドルの高値を付けた。１月限は２．６３ドル高の１１３．４３ドル。    米ＷＴＩ先物は２．１２ドル（２．０８％）高の１０４．１２ドル。     月間ではブレントが１３．６％、ＷＴＩが１５．２％それぞれ上昇した。    英国海軍の海事機関（ＵＫＭＴＯ） によると、３０日にホルムズ海峡で、小型船によって取り付けられた爆発物によってタンカーが攻撃された。攻撃の詳細については、直ちには明らかになっていない。

＜為替＞　円が３日続伸。日銀が政策金利を据え置き、物価見通しを引き上げたことが材料となったほか、米国債利回りの低下もドルの重しとなった。 

日銀は３０日、金融政策決定会合で金利の据え置きを決定した。ただ、金融政策はよりタカ派的な新たな局面に入ったと強調し、数カ月に１度のペースでの利上げに踏み切る可能性を示唆した。 

円は対ドルで０．１１％高の１ドル＝１５７．５１円。ただ、月間では下落する見通しとなった。

主要通貨に対するドル指数は横ばいの１０１．８８。月間では２カ月続伸となる見通し。 

ユーロは０．１２％安の１．１１６８ドル。月間では２カ月続落となる見通し。

来週はイングランド銀行（英中央銀行）とオーストラリア準備銀行（中央銀行）の金融政策決定会合が注目される。 

英ポンドは０．１５％高の１．３３９６ドル。豪ドルは対米ドルで０．０９％高の０．７０３４５米ドル。いずれも月間ベースで上昇する勢いとなっている。

暗号資産（仮想通貨）のビットコインは２．６１％安の７万６７８０．９３ドル。世界最大の暗号資産（仮想通貨）交換業者バイナンスで、ハッカーの攻撃により６３億ドル相当の資産が流出したことが材料視された。 

ＮＹ外為市場：[USD/J]

＜債券＞　指標となる１０年債利回りの１０月月間の低下幅が３６ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）となり、２３年１２月以来の大きさとなった。週間でも４週連続で低下し、連続低下期間は１年ぶりの長さとなった。

ハイテク関連株の急落で人工知能（ＡＩ）投資への懸念が強まり、安全資産である米国債に資金が流入した。

米１０年債利回りは終盤で６．４ｂｐ低下の４．９２５％。一時は９月半ば以来の低水準を付けた。３０年債利回りは１．９ｂｐ低下の５．３１％で、月間低下幅は同じく２３年１２月以来の大きさとなる見通し。

ＦＲＢの政策金利見通しを反映しやすい２年債利回りは８．１ｂｐ低下の４．５７５％。月間では２０２５年８月以来の大幅低下となる見通し。

経済見通しを示す指標として注目される２年債と１０年債の利回り格差は３４．６ｂｐだった。

物価連動国債（ＴＩＰＳ）と通常の国債の利回り差で、期待インフレを示すブレーク・イーブン・インフレ率（ＢＥＩ）は、５年物が２．４６１％。２９日終盤は２．４６９％だった。１０年物ＴＩＰＳのＢＥＩは２．３３６％だった。 

米金融・債券市場：[US/BJ]

＜株式＞　急落して取引を終えた。ナスダック総合は１日の下落率として６月５日以来の大きさを記録した。２９日に発表されたインテルとアマゾン・ドット・コムの四半期決算が期待外れとなり、人工知能（ＡＩ）関連企業による巨額支出を巡る懸念が一段と強まった。

主要３指数はいずれも大幅に下落。ハイテク株の比率が高いナスダックは２．９％安となった 。

アマゾンは取引が進むにつれて下げ幅を縮めたが、インテル株は２８．６％急落した。 

半導体株は大きく値を下げた。エヌビディアが４．２％安、ＡＭＤが１０．９％安となった。フィラデルフィア半導体指数は７．２％下落し、月間で１５％を超える下げとなった。

サーバー大手のデルとＨＰはそれぞれ１０．８％安、９．６％安だった。 

主要３指数はいずれも週間で下落して取引を終えた。Ｓ＆Ｐ５００とナスダックは月間でも下落したが、ダウは上昇して１０月を終えた。

第３・四半期の決算発表シーズンは折り返し点を過ぎ、Ｓ＆Ｐ５００構成企業のうち２９９社が発表を終えた。ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、このうち８２％が市場予想を上回った。アナリストは現在、Ｓ＆Ｐ５００構成企業の第３・四半期利益が前年同期比３１．６％増加すると予想している。

石油大手エクソンモービルとシェブロンは、ともに四半期利益が市場予想を上回った。エネルギー供給の混乱で利益率が急上昇したことが寄与した。両社株はそれぞれ２．２％高、２．８％高となった。 

コーヒーチェーンのスターバックスは１．８％安。中国事業の売却に伴い、通期売上高が減少するとの見通しを示した。

暗号資産（仮想通貨）関連企業のコインベース、ストラテジー、ロビンフッドは７．２─１０．６％下落した。 世界最大の暗号資産（仮想通貨）交換業者バイナンスで、ハッカーの攻撃により６３億ドル相当の資産が流出したことを受けた。

ニューヨーク証券取引所（ＮＹＳＥ）では値下がり銘柄数が値上がり銘柄数を１．８対１の比率で上回った。ナスダックでは値下がり銘柄数が値上がり銘柄数を３．０３対１の比率で上回った。

米取引所の出来高は１９８億７０００万株で、直近２０営業日の平均１７２億６０００万株を上回った。

米国株式市場：[.NJP]

＜金先物＞　金価格は１年ぶりの安値を付けた。銀、プラチナ、パラジウムも大幅に下落し、テクニカル指標で売られ過ぎの水準に沈んだ。米東部時間午後２時１３分（日本時間３１日午前３時１３分）時点で、金現物は３．５％安の１オンス＝３８８０．９７ドルとなり、２０２５年１０月以来の安値を記録。銀は６．５％安の４９ドルと、１１カ月ぶりに５０ドルを割り込んだ。パラジウムも１０００ドルを下回った。米金先物１２月物の清算値は３．３％安の１オンス＝３８９８．９０ドルだった。

ＮＹ貴金属：[GOL/XJ]

＜米原油先物＞　２％超急騰し、４月末以来の高値で取引を終えた。来週に控える米中間選挙後に、イランとの戦争がさらに激化する可能性に市場が身構える中、ホルムズ海峡でのタンカー攻撃が供給リスクを浮き彫りにした。     清算値は、北海ブレント先物１２月限は２．７６ドル（２．４％）高の１バレル＝１１７．６４ドル。一時、１１８ドルの高値を付けた。１月限は２．６３ドル高の１１３．４３ドル。    米ＷＴＩ先物は２．１２ドル（２．０８％）高の１０４．１２ドル。     月間ではブレントが１３．６％、ＷＴＩが１５．２％それぞれ上昇した。    英国海軍の海事機関（ＵＫＭＴＯ） によると、３０日にホルムズ海峡で、小型船によって取り付けられた爆発物によってタンカーが攻撃された。攻撃の詳細については、直ちには明らかになっていない。  

ＮＹＭＥＸエネルギー：[CR/USJ]

Oct 30 : S&P Global Ratings on Friday revised its outlook on Meta Platforms to "negative" from "stable", citing significant uncertainty around the social media giant's capital spending and free operating cash flow.
Big Tech has historically spent heavily on cloud computing, online advertising and e-commerce, but the AI boom has pushed capital expenditure to dizzying levels, stoking investor concerns about whether the sector can generate returns quickly enough.
Last week, Meta forecast annual capital expenditure between $135 billion-$145 billion after reporting a free cash flow deficit of $2.12 billion in the third quarter. Meta is also planning to tap public markets and sell $97.5 billion in stock to fund the AI buildout.
Meta's ability to monetize its AI investments is more limited than that of its peers, S&P said, adding it was unclear when its revenue streams would generate material contributions exceeding their rising costs over the next few years.

S&P now forecasts Meta will generate FOCF deficits of $39 billion in 2026 and $71 billion in 2027.
The agency said elevated spending could keep FOCF negative beyond 2028 and expects Meta to fund its 2028 cash shortfall entirely with debt.
"Given the lack of clarity around the company's future capex and its very ambitious multi-year AI investment plans, we are less certain that it will curtail its spending as previously anticipated," S&P said.
The ratings agency said it believes Meta's leverage could rise to above 1.0x as early as 2027, which is S&P Global's threshold for the "AA-" issuer credit rating.
"We respectfully disagree with S&P's assertion about Meta's AI monetization capabilities," a Meta spokesperson told Reuters, adding that the company sees "significant product and business opportunities ahead of us, supporting our very strong credit profile."
Meta's leverage increased from 0.1x in 2025, primarily due to its strategy of leasing data-center capacity rather than issuing debt, S&P said.
"If capex remains elevated and continues to grow at a faster pace than we expect, credit profiles will continue to weaken and cash flows will be negative," Naveen Sarma, US media and telecom sector lead at S&P Global Ratings, said.
The company reported long-term debt of $80.92 billion as of September 30.
S&P on Thursday also lowered its outlook on Broadcom to stable from positive, saying the chipmaker's rapid AI growth was increasing its exposure to a few big customers.
Earlier this year, S&P lowered cloud computing giant Oracle's credit rating to "BBB-", one notch above "junk", due to its heavily leveraged balance sheet.

Source: Reuters

円は対ドルで０．１１％高の１ドル＝１５７．５１円。ただ、月間では下落する見通しとなった。

ＦＸストリートのシニアアナリスト、ジョセフ・トレビサニ氏は「市場は日銀にやや失望している」と指摘。「円は足元でやや強含んでいるが、これまでほど強くはない。日銀の動きを打ち消す米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）寄りのバイアスが依然として残っている」と述べた。

主要通貨に対するドル指数は横ばいの１０１．８８。月間では２カ月続伸となる見通し。 

ユーロは０．１２％安の１．１１６８ドル。月間では２カ月続落となる見通し。

来週はイングランド銀行（英中央銀行）とオーストラリア準備銀行（中央銀行）の金融政策決定会合が注目される。 

英ポンドは０．１５％高の１．３３９６ドル。豪ドルは対米ドルで０．０９％高の０．７０３４５米ドル。いずれも月間ベースで上昇する勢いとなっている。

暗号資産（仮想通貨）のビットコインは２．６１％安の７万６７８０．９３ドル。世界最大の暗号資産（仮想通貨）交換業者バイナンスで、ハッカーの攻撃により６３億ドル相当の資産が流出したことが材料視された。

NEW YORK, Oct 30 : Monday will ring in a brand-new trading month, a prospect that appeals to many after a doozy of a last session in October.
A fresh test of this year’s technology rally sent the Nasdaq composite on Friday to its biggest decline since June. Chipmaker Intel and social media firm Reddit fell 29 per cent and Sandisk, a chipmaker that has been one of the great beneficiaries of the AI capital-spending boom, dropped 13 per cent.
Friday’s selloff came after a bruising for the big tech firms at the center of the AI buildout, led by Microsoft, Meta Platforms, Amazon and Google parent Alphabet. Their shares dropped 1 per cent to 2 per cent on Friday following significant declines earlier in the week. 
The four so-called hyperscalers have been collectively responsible for more than a third of all the capital spending undertaken by the current constituents of the S&P 500 over the past 12 months, Capital Economics said, adding that their share seems likely to rise to an even higher level – a prospect that investors are struggling with.

“Now that the combined capital spending boom at the hyperscalers is becoming partly dependent on external financing, investors are becoming more nervous about the sums they are collectively investing and how they are doing it,” said John Higgins, a markets economist at Capital Economics. 
The Nasdaq 100 index of large nonfinancial stocks fell 3.5 per cent after being down more, putting it on the brink of a correction, referring to a 10 per cent decline from its recent high. The Nasdaq composite is down 7.8 per cent from its closing high, after its worst month since March 2025 wiped out a chunk of this year’s AI-fueled gain.
“Investors are voting all of a sudden and all together on who will monetize the investment and who won’t,” said Brian Jacobsen, chief economic strategist at Annex Wealth Management. 
The damage went well beyond technology shares that until lately have ridden positive sentiment higher, reflecting a broad pullback from risk as Treasuries rallied. Silver dropped 6 per cent, putting it down 31 per cent for the year, and gold fell 3.5 per cent, putting it down 10 per cent for 2026. 
But investors said most of the selling in stocks recently is at first blush a case of 'what goes up, must come down'.
"I don't think it's a particularly troublesome leverage issue that we're dealing with. We've had such a huge move up in the whole complex," said Sahak Manuelian, managing director for global equities sales and trading at Wedbush Securities. 
Oil prices rose 2 per cent, adding to concern about the health of a US economy that many investors see as dependent on the AI buildout for its pep. Financial stocks were hit hard, with Goldman Sachs down 4 per cent and Jefferies off 6 per cent. Bitcoin fell 3 per cent after hackers took more than $6 billion from Binance. 
One question facing investors is whether a new month will mean a fresh start, after a day in which many investors headed for the hills rather than waiting to see what happens over the weekend.
"When you've had the parabolic-like moves, it makes for a very nasty downdraft,” Manuelian said. “And I think that's what we're seeing. And then you have people that are starting to pull money out and going to other areas."

Source: Reuters

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [３０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[３０日 ロイター] - 米国務省は３０日、ウクライナにロシアの弾道ミサイル迎撃に不可欠な地対空ミサイルシステム「パトリオット」ＰＡＣ３ミサイル５００発を推定２１億ドルで売却することを承認したと発表した。

同省は声明で、同ミサイルの費用について、ウクライナは米国の「ジャンプスタート」プログラムを通じて調達されるカナダ、ドイツ、ノルウェーからの拠出金に加え、欧州連合（ＥＵ）の「ウクライナ支援融資」で賄われる国家資金で支払う予定だと明らかにした。 

ミサイル引き渡しの遅れは、米国とウクライナ間の緊張を高めていた。ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は今週、ロシアがエネルギーや民間インフラへの攻撃を強める中、ウクライナは重要なミサイル供給を米国が承認するのを１カ月近く待っていると述べていた。

items.body:
［ニューヨーク　３０日　ロイター］ - 米国株式市場は急落して取引を終えた。ナスダック総合は１日の下落率として６月５日以来の大きさを記録した。２９日に発表されたインテルとアマゾン・ドット・コムの四半期決算が期待外れとなり、人工知能（ＡＩ）関連企業による巨額支出を巡る懸念が一段と強まった。

主要３指数はいずれも大幅に下落。ハイテク株の比率が高いナスダックは２．９％安となった 。

アマゾンは取引が進むにつれて下げ幅を縮めたが、インテル株は２８．６％急落した。 

半導体株は大きく値を下げた。エヌビディアが４．２％安、ＡＭＤが１０．９％安となった。フィラデルフィア半導体指数は７．２％下落し、月間で１５％を超える下げとなった。

サーバー大手のデルとＨＰはそれぞれ１０．８％安、９．６％安だった。 

ニューヨークのウェルススパイア・アドバイザーズのシニアバイスプレジデント、オリバー・パーシュ氏は「今日だけでなく、今週はＡＩ投資に見合う利益が得られるのか、得られるとすればどれほど早く実現するのかが、大きな焦点だったと言える」と述べた。

主要３指数はいずれも週間で下落して取引を終えた。Ｓ＆Ｐ５００とナスダックは月間でも下落したが、ダウは上昇して１０月を終えた。

第３・四半期の決算発表シーズンは折り返し点を過ぎ、Ｓ＆Ｐ５００構成企業のうち２９９社が発表を終えた。ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、このうち８２％が市場予想を上回った。アナリストは現在、Ｓ＆Ｐ５００構成企業の第３・四半期利益が前年同期比３１．６％増加すると予想している。

石油大手エクソンモービルとシェブロンは、ともに四半期利益が市場予想を上回った。エネルギー供給の混乱で利益率が急上昇したことが寄与した。両社株はそれぞれ２．２％高、２．８％高となった。 

コーヒーチェーンのスターバックスは１．８％安。中国事業の売却に伴い、通期売上高が減少するとの見通しを示した。

暗号資産（仮想通貨）関連企業のコインベース、ストラテジー、ロビンフッドは７．２─１０．６％下落した。 世界最大の暗号資産（仮想通貨）交換業者バイナンスで、ハッカーの攻撃により６３億ドル相当の資産が流出したことを受けた。

ニューヨーク証券取引所（ＮＹＳＥ）では値下がり銘柄数が値上がり銘柄数を１．８対１の比率で上回った。ナスダックでは値下がり銘柄数が値上がり銘柄数を３．０３対１の比率で上回った。

米取引所の出来高は１９８億７０００万株で、直近２０営業日の平均１７２億６０００万株を上回った。

2026年10月30日、ニューヨーク証券取引所（NYSE）。REUTERS/Brendan McDermid（ロイター） ［ニューヨーク　３０日　ロイター］ - 米国株式市場は急落して取引を終えた。ナスダック総合は１日の下落率として６月５日以来の大きさを記録した。２９日に発表されたインテルとアマゾン・ドット・コムの四半期決算が期待外れとなり、人工知能（ＡＩ）関連企業による巨額支出を巡る懸念が一段と強まった。

主要３指数はいずれも大幅に下落。ハイテク株の比率が高いナスダックは２．９％安となった 。

アマゾンは取引が進むにつれて下げ幅を縮めたが、インテル株は２８．６％急落した。 

半導体株は大きく値を下げた。エヌビディアが４．２％安、ＡＭＤが１０．９％安となった。フィラデルフィア半導体指数は７．２％下落し、月間で１５％を超える下げとなった。

サーバー大手のデルとＨＰはそれぞれ１０．８％安、９．６％安だった。 

ニューヨークのウェルススパイア・アドバイザーズのシニアバイスプレジデント、オリバー・パーシュ氏は「今日だけでなく、今週はＡＩ投資に見合う利益が得られるのか、得られるとすればどれほど早く実現するのかが、大きな焦点だったと言える」と述べた。

主要３指数はいずれも週間で下落して取引を終えた。Ｓ＆Ｐ５００とナスダックは月間でも下落したが、ダウは上昇して１０月を終えた。

第３・四半期の決算発表シーズンは折り返し点を過ぎ、Ｓ＆Ｐ５００構成企業のうち２９９社が発表を終えた。ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、このうち８２％が市場予想を上回った。アナリストは現在、Ｓ＆Ｐ５００構成企業の第３・四半期利益が前年同期比３１．６％増加すると予想している。

石油大手エクソンモービルとシェブロンは、ともに四半期利益が市場予想を上回った。エネルギー供給の混乱で利益率が急上昇したことが寄与した。両社株はそれぞれ２．２％高、２．８％高となった。 

コーヒーチェーンのスターバックスは１．８％安。中国事業の売却に伴い、通期売上高が減少するとの見通しを示した。

暗号資産（仮想通貨）関連企業のコインベース、ストラテジー、ロビンフッドは７．２─１０．６％下落した。 世界最大の暗号資産（仮想通貨）交換業者バイナンスで、ハッカーの攻撃により６３億ドル相当の資産が流出したことを受けた。

ニューヨーク証券取引所（ＮＹＳＥ）では値下がり銘柄数が値上がり銘柄数を１．８対１の比率で上回った。ナスダックでは値下がり銘柄数が値上がり銘柄数を３．０３対１の比率で上回った。

米取引所の出来高は１９８億７０００万株で、直近２０営業日の平均１７２億６０００万株を上回った。
